_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking prices live at the airport shops…

annotations.title: Check prices live at the airports

description: Check a product's prices live at every airport shop that sells it: SkyBuyFly opens each shop's page now and confirms the current price. Every offer comes back marked live_confirmed (checked just now) or stored (the last observed price, with its date), cheapest first. Takes about 5-15 seconds. Relevant when a traveller wants current prices or is deciding where to buy. A check of the same product within a minute returns the same result; when SkyBuyFly's price service is busy the answer is rate_limited and lists no offers.

currency.description: A 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR (any case; default USD), that every price is shown in; list_currencies has every one.
currency.title: Currency

product_id.description: A SkyBuyFly product_id exactly as search_products, lookup_barcode or get_featured_products answered it: 32 lowercase hex characters or a dashed UUID.
product_id.title: Product Id

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the airports' shops to answer: a whole number from 5 to 20 (default 12); offers not confirmed by then are returned with their stored price.
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds

name: get_live_prices

AirportPrice.description: A product's price at one airport, in the requested currency.
AirportPrice.title: AirportPrice

LiveSummary.description: How a live check went: offers checked, confirmed, failed, and shown with their stored price only.
LiveSummary.title: LiveSummary

Money.description: An amount in an ISO 4217 currency, rounded to cents.
Money.title: Money

Offer.description:
One shop's offer: at one airport, or a retailer-wide online shop (``scope``), whose airport fields are null.

An ``online_shop`` offer is a real shop price, never one of a card's ``airports``.
Offer.title: Offer

ProductCard.description:
One product with its price at every airport that sells it (cheapest first).

``lowest_price``/``highest_price`` span every comparable shop price, online shops included
(``lowest_price_scope`` says where the lowest is); ``airports`` lists airport prices only. ``offer_count`` is the
number of shop offers the API knows for the product (null where the answer does not say). ``size`` is the API's
own measure ("100 ml"; null where the answer carries none).
ProductCard.title: ProductCard

outputSchema.description: ``get_live_prices``; ``retry_after_seconds`` is set when rate limited, ``reason`` when unavailable.
outputSchema.title: LiveResult

title: Check prices live at the airports
